scope: frozen event localizer validation on new temporal blocks; no production promotion from a small sample
cohort_policy: up to first4 existing selected N-origin RELEASEs per block, chronological timestamp then ID; all eligible others reported; no choice by video outcomes or method; never replace occluded tracks
refinement_policy: union of 0.25s grid from floor(old_seed_media)-2 through ceil(old_seed_media)+3 for every cohort track; plus ceil(old_seed_media)+4 for every track and +6,+8 for first track; cap100 per block, no favorable-case substitutions
clock_check: frozen H/delta; native video bbox center/75percent height as before;50px declared allowance; compute conditional sets with original declared delta domain[-5,5], not earlier training-track availability bound; no refit; missing/clipped anchors unavailable
review_policy: seal ALL event/localizer outputs before loading video; direct native-pixel motion brackets with sustained support; source-track identity provisional unless separately supported; head GREEN/YELLOW/RED appearance brackets separate from vehicle onset; window edges are censoring only
metrics: all selected counts and UNKNOWN; old/new distances to video brackets and conditional-clock compatibility, per block; point-in-bracket descriptive only; method-specific vehicle-after-H1 intervals without fitting a universal delay prior
integration_gate: no default promotion: small same-video sample cannot certify lamp timing; retain every incompatibility/ambiguous event and identify concrete blocker before downstream integration
holdout_scope: new labels and tracks withheld from previous calibration, disjoint within same video/day, not an independent intersection/day
